== Name

callout-subs - substitutions beside callouts

== Synopsis

Callout substitution controls.

== Description

[[target]]
Target paragraph.

[source,xml,subs="+replacements"]
----
<tag>S01 (C) & literal</tag> <!--1--> <!--2-->
----
<1> Replaced XML suffix.
<2> Second replaced suffix.

[source,text,subs="+macros,+quotes,+attributes,+replacements"]
----
S02 {name} (C) https://example.org[Link & é中] <1> <2>
S03 *Bold & é中* _Italic_ <3><4>
S04 pass:[<em>raw &amp; é中</em>] <5> <6>
S05 ((Index & é中)) anchor:code-target[]xref:target[Target] <7> <8>
S06 footnote:note[Note text.] <9><10>
----
<1> First link marker.
<2> Second link marker.
<3> First formatted marker.
<4> Second formatted marker.
<5> First raw marker.
<6> Second raw marker.
<7> First index marker.
<8> Second index marker.
<9> First footnote marker.
<10> Second footnote marker.

[source,text,linenums,start=10,highlight="10,11",subs="+macros"]
----
S07 https://example.org/multiline[First
Second] <1><2>
----
<1> First marker after a multiline link.
<2> Second marker after a multiline link.

[source,xml,subs="-callouts"]
----
<tag>S08</tag> <!--1--> <!--2-->
----

[source,text,subs="specialcharacters"]
----
S09 <1> <2> (C) https://example.org[Literal]
----

See <<code-target,code>>. Reuse footnote:note[].
